mapper.insert: INSERT INTO social_comment (post_id, parent_id, reply_to_user_id, user_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{parentId}, #{replyToUserId}, #{userId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT id, post_id, parent_id, reply_to_user_id, user_id, content, created_at FROM social_comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY id ASC
